subject: Happy Independence Day from LinkUpNaija
headline: Happy Independence Day, {name}
body: Nigeria is sixty-six today. Sixty-six years of a country that never does anything quietly, which is roughly the point of this whole platform. Thank you for being here. If you are in Abuja and still looking for somewhere to be this week, there is a free one on Tuesday: the AITF LinkUp Jollof Party at the Trade Fair complex. Nobody has to approve you, tap Join and you are in.
